mapper.select: SELECT id, store_id, wh_code, wh_name, temp_zone, is_default, status FROM ph_warehouse WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.id, l.warehouse_id, l.location_code, l.location_type, l.max_capacity, l.status FROM ph_location l JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND w.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND l.deleted = b'0' AND w.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_batch b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.warehouse_id = #{id} AND b.deleted = b'0' AND (b.qty_total != 0 OR b.qty_avail != 0 OR b.qty_frozen != 0)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_location_stock s LEFT JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND (l.warehouse_id = #{id} OR b.warehouse_id = #{id}) AND s.deleted = b'0' AND (s.qty != 0 OR s.qty_frozen != 0))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_location l WHERE l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND l.warehouse_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_po_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND o.warehouse_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_po_receipt r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND r.warehouse_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_batch b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.warehouse_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_stocktake t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND t.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND t.warehouse_id = #{id})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_stocktake t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND t.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND t.deleted = b'0' AND (t.warehouse_id IS NULL OR t.warehouse_id = #{id}) AND t.status != 3) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_lock k LEFT JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = k.location_id AND l.tenant_id = k.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = k.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = k.tenant_id WHERE k.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND k.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND k.deleted = b'0' AND k.status NOT IN (1, 2) AND (l.warehouse_id = #{id} OR b.warehouse_id = #{id})) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_damage d JOIN ph_inv_damage_line dl ON dl.damage_id = d.id AND dl.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = dl.location_id AND l.tenant_id = dl.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = dl.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = dl.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND d.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND d.deleted = b'0' AND dl.deleted = b'0' AND d.status NOT IN (3, 4) AND (l.warehouse_id = #{id} OR b.warehouse_id = #{id}))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.qty < 0 OR s.qty_frozen < 0 OR s.qty_frozen > s.qty OR b.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS invalid_rows FROM ph_inv_location_stock s LEFT JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND b.drug_id = s.drug_id AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.deleted = b'0' WHERE s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND s.location_id = #{id} AND s.deleted = b'0'

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_location_stock s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND s.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_flow f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND f.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_lock k WHERE k.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND k.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND k.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_stocktake_line sl JOIN ph_inv_stocktake t ON t.id = sl.stocktake_id AND t.tenant_id = sl.tenant_id WHERE sl.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND sl.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_inv_damage_line dl JOIN ph_inv_damage d ON d.id = dl.damage_id AND d.tenant_id = dl.tenant_id WHERE dl.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND d.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND dl.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_po_receipt_line rl JOIN ph_po_receipt r ON r.id = rl.receipt_id AND r.tenant_id = rl.tenant_id WHERE rl.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND r.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND rl.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_sale_order_line sol JOIN ph_sale_order so ON so.id = sol.order_id AND so.tenant_id = sol.tenant_id WHERE sol.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND so.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND sol.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_sale_return_line srl JOIN ph_sale_return sr ON sr.id = srl.return_id AND sr.tenant_id = srl.tenant_id WHERE srl.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND sr.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND srl.location_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_drug d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND d.default_location_id = #{id})
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_warehouse SET wh_code = #{q.value.whCode}, wh_name = #{q.value.whName}, temp_zone = #{q.value.tempZone}, status = #{q.value.status}, updater = #{actor}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{q.id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE ph_location SET location_code = #{q.value.locationCode}, location_type = #{q.value.locationType}, max_capacity = #{q.value.maxCapacity,jdbcType=BIGINT}, status = #{q.value.status}, updater = #{actor}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{q.id} AND warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'
UPDATE ph_warehouse SET deleted = b'1', updater = #{actor}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0'
UPDATE ph_location SET deleted = b'1', updater = #{actor}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'
